questions.question: God told the prophet Samuel to anoint a man from the tribe of Benjamin to be what over Israel?
When the prophet Samuel anointed Saul, what did he do with a flask of oil?

answers.text: Gave it to Saul to keep

questions.question: Saul, son of Kish, was handsome and without equal among the Israelites. What else made him stand out?

answers.text: He was a head taller than anyone
He was the fastest runner in Israel
He was the strongest man in Benjamin

questions.question: After Samuel anointed him, Saul told his uncle what Samuel had said about the kingship. True or false?
